title: Finance » Search Subscriptions
text:
## Finance » Search Subscriptions
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000091511
The Search Subscriptions page provides the admin with a set of filters to search and edit subscriptions for all site members.
This page can be found by navigating to Finance » Search Subscriptions (1) in the admin area of a site. The filters (2) are at the top of the page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186415542/original/z8zKzE7PNNhs15bVdBSkmHHUsuY94sgdRw.png?1791392570 | alt: Search Subscriptions selected in the Finance menu (1) and the subscription search filters (2).]
These are the available filters to search for subscriptions:
Search by Member Name or Member ID
Member Email
Date Created
Next Due Date
Subscription Date Ended
Subscription ID
Invoice ID
Membership Plan (Product)
Member Status
Subscription Status
Billing Cycle*
Coupon Code Used
When searching by billing cycles, the admin can select more than one option here:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186415543/original/FbjjNynyLQbxk-N6g5YKNpdhjhrbYk9Zkg.png?1791392571 | alt: Billing Cycles filter (1) open on Search Subscriptions, with a checkbox for each billing cycle (2).]
In the results, hovering over the member's name (1) will display information about the member along with several links to take actions on the member (2):
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186370048/original/Q5eTXWxaLhC8Ypr65tMVWhfWjoLq65Uh-A.png?1791333898 | alt: Hovering over a subscription's member (1) opens a card with the member's ID, status, email and action links (2).]
Account Details: Links to the member's Account Details page, which contains an overview of information about the specific member.
Quick Edit: Edit several attributes of the member without logging into their account.
Compose Email: Send an email to the member. Use an existing email template or send a custom email.
Update Credit Card: Update the payment method associated with this member.
View Live Profile: View the live profile of the member as seen by visitors to the website.
Login as Member: Login to the member's dashboard as if they logged in to their account.
Payment History: See the complete billing history of this member.
Change Password: Assign a new password for the member.
Clicking the ID (1) will show all transactions related to this subscription:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186367463/original/fSkAmEnpA657B69u8NSwLKZxBbBki1bl7w.png?1791330011 | alt: The subscription ID link (1) in the Created column, which opens all transactions for that subscription.]
The Next Payment (1) and Subscription (2) columns will display important information about the next due date and the current membership plan. An ended subscription shows None as its next payment:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186367464/original/gUpwoG2UsoRu3gJyB8yDMYAV_iJ2D1xmkQ.png?1791330012 | alt: The Next Payment (1) and Subscription (2) columns of a subscription row; an ended subscription shows None as its next payment.]
Clicking the payment count in the History column (1), such as 1 Paid , will open the Payments Received tab in the Transaction History , filtered to this subscription:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186370049/original/x4GrKhF6XEMY6B26JYyu1ifX46uISXCzdw.png?1791333899 | alt: The History column (1) of an active subscription, showing the 1 Paid link and the total paid.]
Hover over the Actions drop-down menu (1) to Edit the Subscription or End the Subscription (2):
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186730100/original/dyCyleqUt2DUYsoC8435euaxfpC8huMnyw.png?1791925381 | alt: Search Subscriptions Actions menu with Edit Subscription and End Subscription]
End Subscription opens the Cancel Subscription? window, which warns that ending the subscription stops all future payments. It includes an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters) to record why the subscription is being cancelled. Click Yes, continue to end the subscription, or No, cancel to close the window. Leaving the reason blank ends the subscription exactly as before.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186367604/original/N8rd9uJLNgY7VOJ-Mn6jOq8rHG_IjBWDjw.png?1791330200 | alt: Cancel Subscription window with the optional Reason for cancelling box]
Once a subscription is ended, its Status shows Ended , and the History column can show the date it ended. When a reason was entered, the History column also shows a Reason: line with that text. The steps for every way to end a subscription are in How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders .
Edit Subscription opens the Edit Member Subscription window, where the following can be changed:
Enter Payment Amount
Billing Cycle
Next Payment Due Date
Internal Subscription Notes , to record notes with this subscription
When the subscription has past due or upcoming invoices, the window also shows Delete Past Due / Upcoming Invoices? (with the number of invoices). It defaults to Yes , which is recommended because invoices are created 14 days before the recurring due date. Continue & Save Changes saves the changes, and Cancel, Do Not Save Changes closes the window without saving.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12186370050/original/Sv1_T40xHnwaDVIcTcUO2dzmf61iDCOr2Q.png?1791333900 | alt: Edit Member Subscription window with Enter Payment Amount (1), Billing Cycle (2), Next Payment Due Date (3) and Internal Subscription Notes (4).]
For additional questions or help setting this up, please submit a ticket to support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket HERE .
